scope: Actual full24 same-observation yaw endpoint21.905s and candidate; all future geometry remains a frozen hypothesis

prerim_height_boundary.definition: whole frozen bear minZ first reaches highest actual body-rim vertex Z; height condition only, not actual open-mouth crossing or containment

limitations: All source shapes are actual full24 yaw endpoint; do not reuse full23 frozen geometry.
Continuous proof covers straight translation of frozen full-tetrahedron solids, not actual deformed tracking, joint path FK error, rotation or slipping.
The pre-rim boundary only means minimum teddy height reaches highest actual rim vertex, not proven mouth crossing.
Free rear-handle contact later in insertion is not excluded; no dynamic success is certified.
